Goku has faced some pretty damn serious adversaries. I'd say at a lower power level, not yet Super Saiyan, he can handle most of the comic book superheroes. Hell, he could probably take a good 50% of them when he was just the child in Dragon Ball. Batman is a pretty serious deal, especially seeing as he held ground against Superman. But what is the source of Batman's might? His technology. Batman has vast wealth that allows him access to high tech weapons and equipment. We know Goku defeats a similar adversary who also uses high tech military weapons and equipment to enforce its might - the Red Ribbon Army, who Goku also defeats, as a child.

The only real exception is Superman. And when you think about it, Superman and Goku actually share quite a bit in common...

Goku and Superman are both aliens, sent in one-man space pods across the galaxy from their home planets shortly after birth, by their fathers, because their home planets were being destroyed. They were each found in rural areas and raised by virtuous father figures. They are also both tracked and confronted by the last few remaining members of their race, who demand that the castaways join forces with them, or perish. Because of their other-wordy origins, they are unfathomably stronger, faster, and more endurant than any humans on Earth. And of course, each is a champion of moral fortitude. And they both eventually learn to fly. Superman has laser and x-ray vision. Goku has Ka-me-ha-me-ha waves and instantaneous movement. And spirit bombs.

So right now it's looking more or less even. Now about the kryptonite. Superman is invincible to anything but kryptonite because of the Earth's sun, a yellow sun. So, around other starts than our own, for example any red star, he becomes as mortal as a normal human being. Were Superman to be brought suddenly to a red star, one could kill him with anything that would kill a regular man.

Goku has used instantaneous movement to transport himself, with his enemy, across the galaxy, instantaneously. This would be his best strategy against Superman. And in the event that Superman is too strong for Goku at his black-haired power level, Goku can easily heighten his strength exponentially by turning Super Saiyan. And in case that's still not enough, he can go to SS 2, 3 and even 4. But so long as he gets Superman to a planet near a red sun, he won't really even have to try to defeat Superman.

I think the answer to OP's question is that the only character who he COULD NOT beat would be God.
